title: Every Pisot number is a two-sided limit of Salem numbers
abstract: Proves Salem’s two-sided approximation theorem for Pisot numbers, preserving both the polynomial reciprocal-family construction and the exceptional quadratic-unit construction.

informal.SalemTheorem.salem_theorem: Every Pisot number is approached by Salem numbers from both below and above.
informal.SalemTheorem.salem_construction_two_side: For the nondegenerate Pisot polynomial pattern, reciprocal-family polynomials have Salem roots arbitrarily near the Pisot root from either side.
informal.SalemTheorem.salem_quadratic_unit: The quadratic-unit family supplies Salem roots approaching each reciprocal quadratic Pisot unit from either side.
